name: atelie-natal
description: Loja Ateliê Natal em TypeScript (API Express + front-end tipado)

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.dev: npm run build:client && tsx watch src/server/index.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.netlify.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:payments && npm run test:netlify
